evidence.text:
何次道徃瓦官寺禮拜甚勤阮思曠語之
曰卿志大宇宙勇邁終古
何曰卿今日何故忽見推阮曰我圖
數千戸郡尚不能得卿廼圖作佛不亦大乎

judgment.explanation: The mention 岳 refers to Emperor Kang (康帝), whose personal name is 司馬岳. Annotation 003 states 帝諱岳字世同, confirming that 岳 is the personal name of the emperor. The candidate 潘岳 (Pan Yue) is a different historical figure. However, the supplied candidate c0 is 潘岳, which does not match. Wait — the candidate evidence text is just '岳' and the name is 潘岳. The annotation 003 clearly identifies 岳 as the emperor's personal name (帝諱岳), not 潘岳. The candidate 潘岳 is a Jin dynasty poet, not the emperor. This is a mismatch. The likely referent is Emperor Kang (司馬岳), who is not among the supplied candidates. So candidate_missing.

The mention 亮 refers to 庾亮 (Yu Liang). Annotation 002 states 兄亮, identifying him as the elder brother of 庾冰. Annotation 001 mentions 太尉亮. The candidate 亮 is the local person form matching 庾亮. Supported.
The mention 亮 appears within 太尉亮 in annotation 001. This refers to 庾亮, the Grand Commandant (太尉). The candidate 亮 matches this person. Supported.
The mention 平仲 is the courtesy name of 庾冰 (Yu Bing). Annotation 002 states 平仲累遷車騎將軍江州剌史, and annotation 001 states 庾冰字季. The candidate 平仲 matches this person. Supported.

The surface 充 in annotation 005 refers to 何充 (He Chong). The annotation describes 充 being uneasy and seeking an external post after 氷 was sent to guard Wuchang, matching the context of 何充 in the succession debate. 沈充 (c0) is a different person; the 充 here is the abbreviated personal name of 何充, not 沈充.
庾季堅 is the courtesy name of 庾冰, as confirmed by Liu annotation 001 which states 庾冰字季堅. The local candidate 庾季堅 correctly identifies this person as 庾冰, one of the two chief ministers alongside 何充.

The pronoun 臣 in annotation 006 is the first-person pronoun used by the speaker 何充, who says '臣無與焉' (I had no part in it). This is 何充 speaking, distinct from 庾冰. The candidate 何充 (c1) is the correct referent; 沈充 (c0) is not the speaker here.

The surface 何充 in annotation 004 is the full name of He Chong, who advocates for the young prince in the succession debate. Candidate c0 (何充) matches this directly. Candidate c1 (沈充) is a different person and contradicts the context.

The mention 氷 is the abbreviated personal name of 庾冰 (Yú Bīng), the younger brother of 庾亮. The candidate c0 is the local person form 氷, which directly matches the surface form. The annotation 005 text '氷不宜出' refers to the same person discussed throughout the passage, and annotation 001 identifies 庾冰 as 亮之弟 with courtesy name 季堅. The main text confirms 庾冰 as the person credited for the emperor's accession.

The mention 氷 in annotation 006 is the personal name of 庾冰, the younger brother of 庾亮. The candidate c0 matches the surface form 氷 directly. Annotation 001 confirms 庾冰字季堅 and that he is 亮之弟. The main text and other annotations consistently refer to the same person throughout the passage.

The mention 庾冰 in the main text is the full name of Yu Bing, the person credited by He Cidao for the emperor's accession. The candidate c0 matches the surface form 庾冰 directly. Annotation 001 identifies 庾冰 as the younger brother of 庾亮 with courtesy name 季堅, and the main text's 庾季堅 at the start refers to the same person.

The mention 庾冰 in annotation 001 is the full name of Yu Bing, identified as the younger brother of 太尉亮 (庾亮) with courtesy name 季堅. The candidate c0 matches the surface form 庾冰 directly. The main text confirms this is the same person discussed throughout the passage.
